agencyName: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals & Licensing (DIAL), Electrical Examining Board
authorityRationale: The board's own standalone document, titled 'Reciprocal Licensing Agreements with Other States' and dated 1/29/2026, stating the complete Journeyman and Master/Electrical-Contractor reciprocal-state lists verbatim, including the asymmetric per-state Iowa-tier mapping on the Master list. This is Iowa's sole published source identifying which states qualify and under what conditions — unlike Wyoming, Texas, or Minnesota, no HTML page restates this list, so this PDF is the load-bearing document for reciprocityRules on both tiers.
reliabilityRationale: Official board PDF, directly authored and dated by DIAL staff. Reliability set slightly below the board's main HTML hub because (a) it is a static downloadable document whose staleness can't be detected without opening the file, and (b) its own stated reciprocal-application conditions do not fully match Iowa's codified administrative rule on one point — see the requiredExperience needs_review flag in both Iowa electrician fact files.
